intent.raw: Refine ui-prototyping-studio integration with the UI pipeline currently being executed.
intent.objective: Produce a refined non-executed integration design and plan for using UI Prototyping Studio as a governed prototype/admission phase in the DomainSpec UI pipeline.
intent.operator_sentence: How can UI Prototyping Studio integrate with the UI pipeline we are executing?

route_menu.context_hint: Choose how aggressively to integrate the studio with the UI pipeline.

items.label: Prototype Gate
items.description: Insert UI Prototyping Studio as an optional phase between UI-SPEC/TEST-SPEC and implementation.

items.label: Pipeline Replacement
items.description: Make the studio own UI pipeline generation and implementation authority.

items.label: BodyWar Spike Only
items.description: Use the studio once for TROQAR without defining a reusable bridge.

technique_overlays.trigger: The integration question can be answered through the canonical refine sequence using local evidence.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each stage consumes prior artifacts and returns a bounded stage artifact or blocked reason.

technique_overlays.trigger: The hidden structure is the relationship between the Studio CLI/governance loop, DomainSpec UI pipeline artifacts, and target app implementation authority.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Design output must name owners, consumed artifacts, produced artifacts, and non-owners for every bridge edge.

technique_overlays.trigger: The target has historical full-vision UI specs and deep-spec dispatch residue that must not override the lean current spine.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Final synthesis must distinguish current spine from provenance/legacy vision and carry unresolved residue forward.

subagent_strategy.trigger: Local evidence is enough for the initial integration refinement.
subagent_strategy.explanation: No role-bound sibling agents are needed unless a later confirmed run requests visual research, architecture red-team, or implementation spike.

steps.name: Context Builder evidence baseline
stop_conditions: Stop if the current studio spine and BodyWar UI pipeline artifacts cannot both be evidenced by local paths.

steps.name: Invoke Define integration baseline
stop_conditions: Stop if the definition makes the studio own target-app implementation or canonical UI spec promotion.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-review
stop_conditions: Stop if a blocker-level owner boundary contradiction remains.

steps.name: Research decision
stop_conditions: Ask before bounded research if a named external-context gap appears.

steps.name: Distill coherent integration unit
stop_conditions: Stop if the selected unit collapses into full UI pipeline replacement or a one-off BodyWar-only spike.

steps.name: Invoke Redefine / Design integration architecture
stop_conditions: Stop if the design lacks consumed artifacts, produced artifacts, gates, and owner boundaries.

steps.name: Interrogation refine-design-review
stop_conditions: Stop if acceptance-critical integration risks remain unnamed.

steps.name: Distill Repair
stop_conditions: Stop if repair cannot keep the prototype gate small enough to execute.

steps.name: Invoke Plan
stop_conditions: Stop if the plan lacks SWU boundaries, validation, or owner-safe handoff.

steps.name: Final Interrogation and Refine synthesis
stop_conditions: Stop if final synthesis cannot name the next route without executing it.

gates.condition: Context must cite concrete paths for studio current spine and BodyWar UI pipeline artifacts.
The studio may own prototype governance and handoff, not canonical UI spec promotion or target app implementation.
External research stays off unless a named gap appears and the operator confirms bounded research.
Every confirmed stage must produce a stage artifact or explicit blocked reason before final synthesis.
The final plan must include smallest working units, validation commands or review checks, and execution receipt expectations.

boundaries.contract: The studio consumes UI-SPEC, TEST-SPEC, visual definitions, and target app constraints as prototype inputs.
The studio returns accepted prototype HTML, annotation comments, revision manifest, and handoff references; it does not mutate the target app directly.

authority.lifecycle: Refine owns integration discovery and synthesis.
authority.execution: Task Session owns later implementation SWUs.
authority.validation: Dispatch validation gates route shape; later task sessions validate runtime changes.
authority.evidence: Studio prototype sessions produce handoff evidence; UI pipeline specs remain canonical inputs.
authority.promotion: Canonical UI spec updates require explicit invoke/refresh or task-session sync, not automatic studio promotion.
